verdicts.reason: Both are nearly the same stacked layout, and both share the same flaws. There is a large dead gap between the headline and the subcopy/CTA row. The flavour pills are in reverse order (Honey Rosemary first, Blood Orange last), and the legal line is illegibly small. A has comfortable ~37px margins and moves the second circle to the top-right, where it stays clear of the content; its only issue is that the top-left circle bleeds under the 'Summer' line. B squeezes everything to ~25px margins, with the CTA and Blood Orange pill almost touching the right edge. B also drops the bottom-right circle behind the Blood Orange pill, an unwanted collision that clutters the bottom corner.
